texts.orig: Purpose: To ensure adequate submetering equipment, consumer protections and energy efficiency protections are in place.
texts.text: Purpose: To ensure adequate submetering equipment, consumer protections and energy efficiency protections are in place.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Substance of proposed rule: The Commission is considering the petition filed by Archer Ave Holdings LLC (Owner) on June 18, 2026, seeking authority to submeter electricity to a new rental building with fair-market and affordable units at 147-27 Archer Avenue, Jamaica, New York located in the service territory of Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc. (Con Edison). The Commission is also considering the Owner's request for a waiver of 16 NYCRR § 96.5(k)(3), which requires an energy audit for buildings where 20 percent or more of the residents receive income-based housing assistance.
texts.text: Substance of proposed rule: The Commission is considering the petition filed by Archer Ave Holdings LLC (Owner) on June 18, 2026, seeking authority to submeter electricity to a new rental building with fair-market and affordable units at 147-27 Archer Avenue, Jamaica, New York located in the service territory of Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc. (Con Edison). The Commission is also considering the Owner's request for a waiver of 16 NYCRR § 96.5(k)(3), which requires an energy audit for buildings where 20 percent or more of the residents receive income-based housing assistance.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: In the petition, Archer Ave Holdings LLC requests authorization to take electric service from Con Edison and then distribute and meter that electricity to its residents. Once approved by the Commission, submetering of electricity to residential tenants is allowed so long as it complies with the protections and requirements of the Commission's regulations in 16 NYCRR Part 96.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The Owner states that, because the building is new construction subject to the current New York State Energy Conservation Construction Code, which provides strict energy conservation requirements for new and renovated buildings, including the design and construction of energy-efficient building envelopes, mechanical, lighting and power systems, an energy audit is not necessary.

texts.orig: Subject: A process for offering flexible interconnection service options.
texts.text: Subject: A process for offering flexible interconnection service options.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Purpose: To provide rules that ensure safe and adequate service at just and reasonable rates.
texts.text: Purpose: To provide rules that ensure safe and adequate service at just and reasonable rates.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Substance of proposed rule: The Public Service Commission (Commission) is considering the July 29, 2026, petition (Petition) by New York State Electric & Gas Corporation and Rochester Gas and Electric Corporation (collectively, the Companies) seeking approval of their proposed tariff amendments to expand the Flexible Interconnection Capacity Solution (FICS) demonstration project. The Companies indicate that the proposed tariff language establishes the terms, conditions, and procedures for Flexible Interconnection applications for distributed energy resources (DERs) to interconnect at Company-identified locations. The Companies explain that the proposed expansion and tariff amendments are intended to enable increased utilization of existing distribution capacity by DERs while maintaining safe and reliable operation of the electric grid.
texts.text: Substance of proposed rule: The Public Service Commission (Commission) is considering the July 29, 2026, petition (Petition) by New York State Electric & Gas Corporation and Rochester Gas and Electric Corporation (collectively, the Companies) seeking approval of their proposed tariff amendments to expand the Flexible Interconnection Capacity Solution (FICS) demonstration project. The Companies indicate that the proposed tariff language establishes the terms, conditions, and procedures for Flexible Interconnection applications for distributed energy resources (DERs) to interconnect at Company-identified locations. The Companies explain that the proposed expansion and tariff amendments are intended to enable increased utilization of existing distribution capacity by DERs while maintaining safe and reliable operation of the electric grid.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Substance of proposed rule: The Public Service Commission (Commission) is considering a petition of National Fuel Gas Distribution Corporation (NFG or the Company), filed on September 1, 2026, for authority to issue long-term securities for permitted purposes under Public Service Law Section 69.
texts.text: Substance of proposed rule: The Public Service Commission (Commission) is considering a petition of National Fuel Gas Distribution Corporation (NFG or the Company), filed on September 1, 2026, for authority to issue long-term securities for permitted purposes under Public Service Law Section 69.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: NFG requests authority to issue up to $500 million of new longterm debt securities at any time through December 31, 2029, for purposes of (1) reimbursement of the Company's treasury for money expended for capital purposes, (2) payment for gross additions to utility plant used and useful in the public service, (3) repayment of shortterm debt obligations outstanding and long-term promissory notes issued by the Company that will mature in 2027 and 2028, and (4) other corporate purposes.
